integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof by explicit matrix commutator, positive matrix products and adjacent swaps; exact-rational standalone verification supplements but does not replace proof; mathematical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Idealized discrete-time single-batch, equal-mass binary-splitting generation bins, fixed per-class positive survival, uniform nonterminal fragmentation fraction within each episode, and no fresh external source; neither real ocean applicability nor empirical survival monotonicity is established.
title: A sharp temporal sorting law for fragmentation under size-selective marine loss
